Overview

Burlington is a city in Ontario with a population of 193,000. A scenic lakeside city on Lake Ontario, known for its Royal Botanical Gardens, waterfront parks, and as a family-friendly suburb of Toronto. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
